headlines.description: — Brandon Miller had 31 points and nine rebounds, LaMelo Ball made seven 3s and scored 24 points and Charlotte held on to beat the Atlanta Hawks 110-107 on Wednesday night, just hours after two of of the Hornets' starters
headlines.shortLinkText: Brandon Miller scores 31 points, Hornets hold on to beat Hawks 110-107

headlines.description: — Sam Merrill scored a career-high 32, Donovan Mitchell added 30, and the Cleveland Cavaliers rolled to a 138-113 victory over the Washington Wizards in James Harden's first home game wearing wine and gold.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sam Merrill scores 32 as Cavaliers beat Wizards 138-113 in James Harden's home debut

headlines.description: — Cam Thomas scored 34 points in his second game with Milwaukee, Kevin Porter Jr. added 18 points, 10 rebounds and 11 assists and the Bucks beat the Orlando Magic 116-108 Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Thomas and Porter power the Bucks to a 116-108 win over the Magic

headlines.description: — Payton Pritchard scored 26 points and the Boston Celtics rolled past the Chicago Bulls 124-105 on Wednesday night in the final game for both teams before the All-Star break.
headlines.shortLinkText: Celtics beat injury-riddled Bulls 124-105 as Vucevic scores 19 against his former team

headlines.description: — Jarace Walker had 23 points, Kam Jones secured the victory with a 3-pointer with 16 seconds remaining, and the short-handed Indiana Pacers beat the Brooklyn Nets 115-110 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pacers beat Nets 115-110 as Kam Jones hits key 3 with 16 seconds left

headlines.description: — Jose Alvarado scored a season-high 26 points and Mikal Bridges added 22 points as the New York Knicks beat the Philadelphia 76ers 138-89 Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alvarado and Bridges pace Knicks to a 138-89 rout of the 76ers

headlines.description: — Cade Cunningham scored 28 points, Paul Reed had 16 of his 22 in the first quarter and the Detroit Pistons beat the Toronto Raptors 113-95 on Wednesday night in the final game before the All-Star break for both teams.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cunningham scores 28 points, Pistons overcome suspensions to rout Raptors 113-95

headlines.description: — Kawhi Leonard scored 27 points and his three-point play with two seconds remaining lifted the Los Angeles Clippers to a 105-102 victory over the Houston Rockets on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Leonard's three-point play in final seconds lifts Clippers to a 105-102 win over Rockets

events.name: Portland Trail Blazers at Minnesota Timberwolves

headlines.description: — Julius Randle had 41 points and the Minnesota Timberwolves beat Portland 133-109 von Wednesday night to end the Trail Blazers;' winning streak at three.
headlines.shortLinkText: Randle has 41 points and the Timberwolves dominate the Blazers 133-109

events.name: Miami Heat at New Orleans Pelicans

headlines.description: — Bam Adebayo had 27 points, 14 rebounds and four blocks and the short-handed Miami Heat beat the New Orleans Pelicans 123-111 on Wednesday night in the final game for both teams before the All-Star break.
headlines.shortLinkText: Short-handed Heat beat Pelicans 123-111 in final game for both teams before All-Star break

events.name: Oklahoma City Thunder at Phoenix Suns

headlines.description: — Jalen Williams scored 28 points, Isaiah Joe added 21 and the hot-shooting Oklahoma City Thunder cruised to a 136-109 victory over the Phoenix Suns on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jalen Williams scores 28 points and the Thunder cruise past the Suns, 136-109

headlines.description: — Jaren Jackson Jr scored 23 points in his home debut to lead the Utah Jazz to a 121-93 victory over the Sacramento Kings on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jaren Jackson Jr. scores 23 in home debut as Jazz deal the Kings their 14th straight loss

headlines.description: — Nikola Jokic and Jamal Murray warmed up for their appearances in the NBA's All-Star festivities by teaming up to help the Denver Nuggets hold off the Memphis Grizzlies 122-116 Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: All-Stars Jokic and Murray lead Nuggets past scrappy Grizzlies 122-116

events.name: San Antonio Spurs at Golden State Warriors

headlines.description: — De'Aaron Fox scored 27 points and Victor Wembanyama added 26 to send the San Antonio Spurs into the All-Star break on a six-game winning streak after beating the Golden State Warriors 126-113 Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fox and Wembanyama lead the Spurs past the Warriors 126-113 for their 6th straight win
